sources.observation: Opcode 49 enables banking and does not open a separate amount-transfer workspace.
The ordinary Swap button requests sound 141 before entering the modal.

Opening Swap quiets every sound channel, requests sound 3003 unless reduced sound is enabled, and while banking is available moves all banked gold, gems, and jewelry into the shared pool; transfers use five gold or one gem or jewelry; Done requests sound 141 and performs no bank mutation.
Forward location departure returns every remaining pooled denomination to the bank and disables banking.
Location cleanup also returns the complete pool to the bank and disables banking.

expectedTrace: quiet existing channels and request modal sound 3003
move all banked denominations to the pool once
perform Pool, Share, or exact character transfers
return the remaining pool to the bank on location departure
